description: Form a reputation-weighted, sybil-deduped panel of K agents to run a quorum — the glue between routing and consensus. One wallet = one seat (even across multiple DIDs). With no candidates, auto-pulls the top trusted set. Then collect each panelist answer and call lawbor_quorum.

candidates.description: Optional pool of 0x/did:key agents. Omit to auto-pull top trusted.

name: lawbor_council
